index_line: - [[psb-alpha-p5]] — 8 Ω (3.9 Ω min), LW ±2.8 dB, f3 56 Hz, sens 83.6 dB, pref 4.0 (ASR)
brand_notes: Alpha P5 won Stereophile Product of the Year 2019 (per maker page) while ASR's Klippel review was negative; maker sensitivity claims exceed measured by 2-3.4 dB (stereophile-psb-alpha-p5, asr-psb-alpha-p5).
takeaways: 5.25in ported two-way, inverted layout; min Z 3.9 ohm (ASR) / 3.85 ohm (Stereophile) at 190 Hz -> effectively-4ohm.
Klippel LW ±2.8 dB, f3 56 Hz, major DI discontinuity, port peak.
THD ~2.7% at 86 dB; >5% at 96 dB; 200 Hz compression sweep benign (~0.5 dB at ~105 dB).
Stereophile/TAS praised balance and bass for size; ASR not recommended.
conflicts: Stereophile 'superbly flat' vs ASR uneven response (different axis/method)
log_bullets: Created speakers/psb-alpha-p5 and 4 source pages (ASR, Stereophile, TAS, mfr)
Conflict: claimed 87 dB vs 83.6-85 dB; ASR vs Stereophile on response flatness; no user reports found
